description: TransLink - Truck Parking is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by TransLink. This dataset shows the locations of officially recognized truck parking facilities in Metro Vancouver. Data sources include the Province of BC and the City of Surrey (. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher TransLink. Its tags are Parking, Translink, Truck Parking. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2020-08-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – TransLink. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
